flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Notice/hook/useStagePermissions (EDITABLE/NON_EDITABLE stage lists for general notice editing, alert mounted but its triggers are commented out in mode/edit/EditView and mode/update/UpdateForm). No warrant-update-specific validation in the six repos
note: The story asks for pre-defined validation (for example processing stage) when the officer searches a notice to update warrant info, with a prompt if invalid. There is no warrant-specific validation because the warrant update feature itself does not exist (see OCMS27.27). What exists is only the general notice-edit stage rule in useStagePermissions (EDITABLE/NON_EDITABLE lists, with court stages CSD/COM/CTW etc. as non-editable). The result is computed but not used to restrict anything, and the alert 'Notice has been submitted to State Court. Please apply DNATA...' never appears because its triggers are commented out in EditView.tsx and UpdateForm.tsx. The story status is blank in the data; the requirement is not given. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim. Only the general notice-edit stage list exists and it restricts nothing; validation specific to warrant update does not exist

steps.step: Warrant update conditions, such as notice stage, are defined
steps.detail: There is no list of conditions specific to updating informasi warrant. The only stage list is EDITABLE/NON_EDITABLE for general notice editing (useStagePermissions.tsx:27-55); no configuration or parameter for warrant conditions.

steps.step: OCMS checks the notice stage against the conditions
steps.detail: useStagePermissions reads the notice last_processing_stage and checks whether it is in the EDITABLE list (NPA, ENA, RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3, CFC, CPC) or NON_EDITABLE list (CSD, CSR, COS, COM, COT, CTM, CTT, CWM, CTW, COW, CWW). This is a general notice-edit rule, not a warrant update condition. The editable result is only passed as a parameter to useNoticeSubmit (ActionNotice.tsx:78) and there it only appears in a dependency array (useNoticeSubmit.tsx:261), with no visible effect. The stage is compared, but nothing is restricted.

steps.step: Officer is prompted when the notice is not valid
steps.detail: The modal alert 'Notice has been submitted to State Court. Please apply DNATA and perform an EMCONs to edit the notice' exists in useStagePermissions.tsx:86, but every caller that would show it (EditView.tsx:228-237 and UpdateForm.tsx:155-163) is commented out, so the prompt never appears. Its text is also about editing a notice, not updating a warrant.

steps.step: Warrant update is blocked or allowed by the result
steps.detail: There is no server-side validation for updating informasi warrant: no warrant update endpoint exists in the six repos (grep returns nothing), so nothing can be rejected or allowed.
